title: 讲师

about:
董晓，山东师范大学计算机与人工智能学院讲师，张化祥教授团队成员，博士毕业于中山大学人工智能学院、广东省大数据分析与处理重点实验室。长期从事多模态人工智能研究，研究方向为多模态大模型和具身智能，聚焦多模态信息统一表征、跨模态理解与生成等关键问题，提出了五模态统一表征、视觉语言细粒度对齐等方法与技术。在 IEEE TPAMI、TMM、CVPR、ICLR 等国际期刊和会议发表论文40余篇，其中中科院一区及 CCF A 类论文20余篇，获授权发明专利7项。

主持首届国家自然科学基金青年学生基础研究项目（博士研究生），作为项目骨干参与科技部重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金面上项目及青年项目、山东省重点研发项目等。多项研究成果已在华为、阿里、美图等企业应用。曾获逸仙学术之星、郭谢碧蓉特等奖学金、国家奖学金等荣誉。参与 CVPR、NeurIPS、IEEE TPAMI、TMM 等会议和期刊的学术服务，担任领域主席、程序委员会委员和审稿人，并组织 CVPR 挑战赛及 PRCV 特色论坛。

en.title: Lecturer

en.about:
Xiao Dong is a lecturer at the School of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Shandong Normal University, and a member of Prof. Huaxiang Zhang’s research team. He received his Ph.D. from the School of Artificial Intelligence and the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Big Data Analysis and Processing at Sun Yat-sen University. His research focuses on multimodal large models and embodied intelligence, with an emphasis on unified multimodal representations, cross-modal understanding, and generation. He has developed methods for unified representations across five modalities and fine-grained vision-language alignment. He has published over 40 papers in international journals and conferences, including IEEE TPAMI, TMM, CVPR, and ICLR; over 20 of these appeared in CAS Q1 journals or CCF A venues. He holds seven granted invention patents.

He leads a project in the inaugural NSFC Basic Research Program for Young Students (Ph.D.) and has contributed as a core team member to the National Key R&D Program, NSFC General Program and Young Scientists Fund projects, and the Shandong Provincial Key R&D Program. His research has been applied at Huawei, Alibaba, and Meitu. His honors include the Yat-sen Academic Star Award, the Guo Xie Birong Special Scholarship, and National Scholarships. His academic service includes area chair, program committee, and reviewer roles for conferences and journals such as CVPR, NeurIPS, IEEE TPAMI, and TMM, as well as organizing CVPR challenges and PRCV thematic forums.
